newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Sept treasury deficit $534 mln - official.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Sept treasury deficit $534 mln - official.

text.p: Argentina posted a treasury deficit of $534 million in September, compared with a $421 million deficit in September 1995, the Economy Ministry said Friday.
In the July-September period the deficit was $1.63 billion, the ministry said. It provided no comparative figure for the third quarter of 1995.
Total revenue for September was $1.25 billion against total expenditure of $1.79 billion.
Tax revenue for the month was $1.01 billion compared to $1.15 billion a year earlier.
Interest expenses were $479 million versus $505.5 million and wage costs were $324 million versus $332 million.
Total revenue for the third quarter was $3.67 billion versus expenditure of $5.3 billion.
